contexts.text: Ahola = the perverted Spiritual Church, which is Samaria... AC 1368.
Ahola, or Samaria = the Church where truths have been falsified.
Ahola and Aholibah, or the tent and habitation of God = Heaven and the Church where there are Divine truth and Divine good... AE 576:6.
Ahola which is Samaria, = the Spiritual Church, and Aholibah, which is Jerusalem, = the Celestial Church.
